scientific_integrity: An exact two-row spectral theorem, with symbolic and numerical reproducibility checks. No claims of independent validation or novelty of the previously published dimension-dependent gap.
scientific_limitations: Real orthonormal two-column frames; two distinct unweighted rows; positive leverage; spectral restriction conditioning, not end-to-end solver convergence. The leverage bound constant is not proved sharp. A potentially overlapping 2022 sensor-design paper was available only through its title/citation.
title: Dimension-free leverage control of E-optimal two-row Krylov sketch distortion
